complete_examples.text: In the model, the tunnel-soil subsystem is modeled using the semi-analytic cylindrical layer elements to improve computational efficiency, while spatial track/tunnel dynamic interactions are employed to couple the tunnel-soil and train-track subsystems.
Subsequently, the established tunnel-soil system model is coupled with a spatial train-track system dynamics model through track/tunnel dynamic interactions, forming a 3D TTTS coupled dynamics model.
